reasons: All quotes and hashes verify. Identity: EO 10071, signed July 20, 1949 by Truman, 14 FR 4587, Southern Pacific Company (Pacific Lines) and the Brotherhood of Railroad Trainmen, matching the catalog and the report (Emergency Board No. 77, which names EO 10071). Inventory: the board clause and the no-change sentence cover every command; the preceding text on the page is EO 10070 and the following text is the signature. Board clause: the transmittal letter dated September 1, 1949 submits the report, so the task was completed on 1949-09-01 under the owner's board rule. No-change sentence: 1949-09-01 + 30 days = 1949-10-01 inclusive, with exclusive 1949-09-30 stated. Whole-order end 1949-10-01 equals the latest clause end. The report records a presidentially approved 30-day extension of the reporting limit (to about 1949-09-18); the report came within it, and the extension is not an end. EO 12553 (1986-02-25) is the only disposition note and is correctly recorded as a later event and formal disposition. No held order names EO 10071 earlier. Savings are honestly described. The text is the FR OCR layer of the official printing, and original pages are not confirmed, as the claim records. The dates now agree with the judgment_reasons, the research_rationale and the sources.
